items.summary_en: Ukraine reported one clade Ib case; Angola, where community transmission has taken hold, has 264 confirmed mpox cases and 2 deaths this year.

items.summary_zh: 蒙古科布多省1例腺鼠疫確定病例,與處理旱獺有關,呼籲勿接觸野生旱獺。
items.summary_en: Mongolia confirmed a bubonic plague case in Khovd Province near the Chinese border, linked to handling marmots; authorities urge avoiding wild marmots.

items.summary_zh: 菲律賓洪災後鉤端螺旋體病6,253例確定、378例死亡,較去年同期減12%。
items.summary_en: The Philippines reported 6,253 confirmed leptospirosis cases and 378 deaths as of 29 August, 12% below last year's level, amid flooding.

items.summary_zh: 法國今年5月至8月沙門氏菌感染81例,6例住院,源於洛特加龍省南瓜子產品。
items.summary_en: France reported 81 Salmonella cases from May to August this year, 6 hospitalised; the source was pumpkin-seed products made in Lot-et-Garonne, now withdrawn.

items.headline_zh: 哥斯大黎加-急性病毒性A型肝炎
items.headline_en: Costa Rica – Acute viral hepatitis A
items.summary_zh: 哥斯大黎加今年772例A型肝炎,逾2025年全年兩倍,73%集中聖荷西省。
items.summary_en: Costa Rica has reported 772 hepatitis A cases this year through week 32, over twice the 2025 full-year total; 73% are in San José Province.

items.summary_zh: 泰國今年截至9/1累計53,362例腸病毒,住院5,408例,較去年同期低。
items.summary_en: Thailand has reported 53,362 enterovirus cases this year as of 1 September, including 5,408 hospitalisations, below the same period last year.

items.summary_zh: 葉門南部貝達地區8月逾1,000例疑似霍亂、6人死亡,快篩及藥物短缺。
items.summary_en: Al-Bayda in southern Yemen reported over 1,000 suspected cholera cases and 6 deaths in August, amid shortages of test kits and drugs.

items.disease_zh: 小兒麻痺症/急性無力肢體麻痺
items.summary_zh: cVDPV2新增12例(剛果等3國),巴基斯坦WPV1環境樣本6件。
items.summary_en: GPEI reported 12 cVDPV2 polio cases in three countries, led by the DRC with 8, and 6 WPV1 environmental detections in Pakistan.
items.area_zh: 剛果民主共和國,奈及利亞,馬利,南蘇丹共和國
items.area_en: Congo,Democratic Republic of the,Nigeria,Republic of Mali,South Sudan,Republic of

items.summary_zh: 美洲今年截至8/22麻疹51,027例、死亡55例,較去年同期增約4.6倍。
items.summary_en: The Americas reported 51,027 confirmed measles cases and 55 deaths as of 22 August, about 4.6 times the same period last year.
items.area_zh: 加拿大,瓜地馬拉,墨西哥,美國

items.summary_zh: 日本疫情上升,流感確定病例6,543例;韓國每千人13.3例,較上週升。
items.summary_en: Japan's influenza epidemic is rising, with 6,543 confirmed cases in week 35; South Korea's ILI rate rose week on week to 13.3 per 1,000.

items.summary_zh: 薩瓦省退伍軍人病48例、2死,30例與尚貝里餐廳噴霧系統有關,關閉後無新增。
items.summary_en: Savoie, France reported 48 Legionnaires' cases and 2 deaths; 30 were linked to a misting system at a Chambéry restaurant, with no new cases since its closure.

items.disease_zh: 腸道出血性大腸桿菌感染症
items.headline_zh: 尼泊爾-大腸桿菌感染症等災後傳染病
items.headline_en: Nepal – Post-flood infectious disease risks (including E. coli infection)
items.summary_zh: 尼泊爾8/26山洪致數千人罹難失蹤,5處飲用水源遭大腸桿菌汙染。
items.summary_en: A flash flood on 26 August in Nepal's Rasuwa area killed or left missing thousands, and five drinking water sources are contaminated with E. coli.

items.summary_zh: 孟加拉登革熱42,590例住院、117死,單日住院1,558例創今年新高。
items.summary_en: Bangladesh reported 42,590 hospitalised dengue cases and 117 deaths as of early September, with 1,558 hospitalised in one day, a yearly high.

items.headline_zh: 中國-亞洲⻑角血蜱正內羅病毒(ALTNV)感染
items.headline_en: China – Asian longhorned tick orthonairovirus (ALTNV) infection
items.summary_zh: 中國3,163例蜱叮咬患者約10.4%檢出ALTNV,部分與SFTS共感染。
items.summary_en: China found Asian longhorned tick orthonairovirus (ALTNV) in about 10.4% of 3,163 patients with tick-bite histories, some co-infected with SFTS virus.
